content.overviewLead: The Metković family has cared for this land across three generations, preserving a kind of Adriatic hospitality that cannot be manufactured.
content.overview:
The family's roots in Molunat reach back to the early eighteenth century. The stone house was built in the 1930s and became known as Villa Palma in 1966. More than sixty years later, Nikša and Sanja continue that story as the third generation of family hosts.

Across approximately 4.8 hectares, centuries-old olive trees, citrus groves, stone terraces and gardens descend toward roughly 300 metres of Adriatic coastline. The estate welcomes only eight guests, allowing the landscape, the sea and the hosts to remain part of the experience.

Molonta was featured in Condé Nast Traveler in 2025 for its family hospitality and waterfront setting. The estate is approximately 20 minutes from Dubrovnik Airport and 40 minutes from Dubrovnik Old Town.
content.experienceStatement: This is privacy with a human presence: Nikša and Sanja live nearby, remain available when needed and give guests the freedom to make the estate their own.

faq.q: What is Molonta Heritage Estate, and was it formerly Villa Palma?
faq.a: Molonta Heritage Estate is the current name of the Metković family's historic waterfront property in Molunat. The family house was built in the 1930s and became known as Villa Palma in 1966; today it is cared for by the third generation.

faq.q: How many guests can stay at Molonta Heritage Estate?
faq.a: Molonta welcomes up to eight guests in four double bedrooms. Each bedroom has its own private en-suite bathroom with a shower.

faq.q: Does Molonta have direct access to the Adriatic Sea?
faq.a: Yes. A private path crosses the grounds to the estate's rocky beach, direct swimming access, a natural sea pool for children, an outdoor shower and a private mooring.
Guests have exclusive use of the villa and approximately 4.8 hectares of Mediterranean grounds. Nikša and Sanja live nearby and remain available while respecting guest privacy.

faq.q: What pool and wellness facilities are available?
faq.a: The estate has a private 14 by 5 metre infinity pool, a hot tub for five guests and an outdoor gym. In-villa massage, yoga and Pilates can be arranged at additional cost.

faq.q: What is included in the nightly rate?
faq.a: The stay includes exclusive use of the estate, Wi-Fi, full air conditioning, private parking, daily housekeeping, towel service, regular linen changes, pool and garden care, final cleaning and complimentary concierge support.

faq.q: Can a private chef or grocery pre-stocking be arranged?
faq.a: Yes. Private chefs, catering and grocery pre-stocking can be arranged on request at additional cost, together with restaurant reservations and locally tailored dining suggestions.

faq.q: Is a private yacht available for guests?
faq.a: A Jeanneau Prestige 34 motor yacht with skipper can be arranged at additional cost for estate guests. Other boat excursions, diving and fishing can also be coordinated.

faq.q: How far is Molonta from Dubrovnik Airport?
faq.a: Molonta is approximately 20 minutes from Dubrovnik Airport by road, depending on traffic. Private airport transfers and pre-arrival coordination can be arranged.

faq.q: How far is Molonta from Dubrovnik Old Town?
faq.a: Dubrovnik Old Town is approximately 40 minutes from the estate by road, depending on traffic and season. Private transfers or a tailored yacht excursion can be arranged.

faq.q: Do guests need to rent a car in Molunat?
faq.a: A rental car is useful but not essential. Airport transfers, drivers and tailored excursions can be arranged, while restaurants and everyday services are available in and around Molunat.

faq.q: Is Molonta suitable for families with children?
faq.a: Yes. Families have extensive private grounds, a natural sea pool, an entertainment house and family support that can be arranged. A cot, high chair and babysitting can be requested before arrival.

faq.q: Can the estate host retreats, celebrations or small weddings?
faq.a: Private retreats, wellness stays, small weddings and carefully planned celebrations may be considered. Guest count, suppliers, timing and use of the estate are reviewed before confirmation.

faq.q: What are the 2027 rates and minimum stays?
faq.a: Owner-supplied 2027 rates begin at €2,140 per night in May and October. Minimum stays are three nights outside high summer and seven nights with Saturday arrivals in July and August. A written quote confirms the applicable rate and total.
Availability is checked personally for every request. The written quote confirms dates, rate, inclusions, applicable taxes, security deposit and booking terms before payment.
